# Connect existing repository (`connect_existing_repository`)

MCP tool `vault_actions_connectRepository` · scope `access_repo_connect` · write

Brings a repository the caller's GitHub connection can read under Samebase's record (access is what
is checked — not ownership): creates the vault, syncs the tree, and leaves the providers
deliberately unconfigured — importing never touches Convex or Cloudflare. This is the adoption entry
point for existing projects; attach providers afterwards with `connect_convex_deployment` and
`connect_cloudflare_worker`, or leave the app GitHub-only (watching and editing a repository is a
supported use on its own).

Preconditions: a GitHub provider connection, and read access to the repository. Nothing is created
on any provider; the only writes are Samebase's own record and the tree sync. Progress and failure
are readable through `get_user_vaults` (`sourceSetup` running/failed with step and message).

## Arguments

- `repositoryFullName` (string, required): Full repository name to import, as "owner/name".

## Returns

Convex validator JSON of the tool's `structuredContent`:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "value": {
    "vaultId": {
      "fieldType": {
        "type": "id",
        "tableName": "vaults"
      },
      "optional": false
    },
    "runId": {
      "fieldType": {
        "type": "id",
        "tableName": "appProvisioningRuns"
      },
      "optional": false
    }
  }
}
```
